title: ATTP presents its 2024 Annual Activity Report
excerpt: ATTP presents its 2024 Annual Activity Report
body_html:
In 2024, the activity of the National Association of Professional Table Tennis Players of the Republic of Moldova (ATTP) followed the goals and guidelines set out in its own development strategy, activity programme and projects.

In promoting table tennis and a healthy lifestyle, ATTP focused in particular on strengthening the community of table tennis amateurs across the country, building partnerships, developing privileged bilateral relations and joining multilateral coalitions. Special attention was paid to the financial dimension (sponsors) and to age groups (age), with an emphasis on links with organisations that have resources and growing potential.

ATTP’s very busy calendar of activities in 2024 shows that home table tennis has regained its momentum and is able to develop effectively even in complex and difficult conditions.
